_readme: Endpoint settings for Prompt Enhancer, Prompt Director and Image Captioner.
These live here instead of in node inputs on purpose: ComfyUI stores widget
values verbatim in every saved workflow and in image metadata, and stores them
as a positional array with no field names, so a key typed into a node panel
would be written to disk, travel with any shared workflow or exported image,
and could not even be scrubbed afterwards.
Editing this file takes effect on the next run; no ComfyUI restart needed.
Leave api_key empty for local llama.cpp, which needs no key.
per_node entries override the top-level values; an empty string inherits.
This file is the ONLY source of settings for this pack. No environment
variable is read - not OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_BASE_URL, or any proxy
variable - so behavior here is fully determined by this file.
--- SECURITY NOTICE ---
api_key is stored here in PLAINTEXT, with no encryption and no obfuscation.
Anyone who can read this file can read your key, and this file is not in
.gitignore: if you commit it with a key filled in, that key is published.
Use HTTPS for any non-local api_base. Over plain HTTP your key, your prompts
and your images travel in the clear, readable by anything on the path. Use
http:// only for 127.0.0.1/::1 or another host you control on your own
machine or trusted LAN.
Prefer a scoped, restricted key over a full-access account key, and revoke
and rotate it if this file is ever shared, backed up to a public location,
or committed by accident.
By filling in api_key you accept that you are responsible for protecting it:
choosing the endpoint, choosing the transport, and keeping this file out of
version control and out of shared images. The authors of this pack cannot
see, store, encrypt, or take responsibility for the key you put here, and
accept no liability for any loss or misuse arising from it.
--- END SECURITY NOTICE ---
